must: It tells the user that the PR's patch is the same as in the commit the user reviewed before, for example that it was only rebased, and that the rebase brought in no new problems, rather than presenting a full new review.
It offers to approve again, or asks whether to re-submit the earlier approval or stop.
must_not: It presents review findings, such as that the retry loop retries permanent 4xx errors.
It asks the user whether the earlier review was an approval or a change request.
